156.news_title: Crystal Clear from Every Angle: Best LCD Monitors for Wide Viewing
156.long_description:
We offer the best LCD Monitor for wide viewing angles, perfectly suitable for cocktail tables, 4 player pedestal arcade machines, and public view digital displays. If you’ve ever noticed colors washing out or images distorting when you're not looking at your monitor straight on, you’ve experienced the impact of poor viewing angles firsthand. In this post, we’ll explore what “full viewing angles” really mean, why they matter, and which types of LCD monitors offer the best viewing experience from every angle. Viewing angles describe how well a monitor displays colors and contrast when viewed from off-center positions — such as from the side, above, or below. They are typically expressed in degrees (e.g., 178° horizontal / 178° vertical), indicating how far you can move in either direction before the picture quality begins to degrade. Poor viewing angles can lead to:
  • Washed-out colors
  • Inverted contrast
  • Diminished brightness
  • Ghosting or shadowing
    • Arcooda carefully reviews and tests various LCD panels, then, designs the drive board and firmware to support the best viewing opinions making our monitors highly suitable for public digital displays. All our 16.6inch, 19inch, 20inch, 26inch, 29inch, 32inch, 43inch and 55inch monitors support full viewing angle (178 degrees horizontal and vertical - 89 degrees from any angle). If you are using our monitors for arcade gaming, they are the perfect solution, allowing full view options for your sitdown cocktail table arcade cabinets or multiplayer gaming terminals.
